text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Sounds of Earth is seriously good after all!
Even though she just entered the Senior Class, she can totally hold her own against the veterans!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Things are getting interesting~!
Can't wait for the Tenno Sho (Spring)!"

text_block_list.name: Aurum Star
text_block_list.text: As expected of you, Earth...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: —Bennnnnnissimo!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(Truly magnificent...! Sessions with seasoned musicians
from various generations have a richness
that cannot be found among peers of the same era...!)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah—
Without a doubt, what I seek must lie just beyond this path...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: —...You really look like you're having fun.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Are you always like this,
win or lose?"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
That's right.
I'm always having fun.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Of course, winning makes me happy. Losing makes me frustrated.
Even I have those feelings. But you see—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"All of those included—
are what make up the music of racing.
And I love music."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: That's why any race is a blast!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...From today's run,
I kind of got that side of Earth-san. But――

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...I don't wanna lose.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
To think that even though I couldn't pull off the win...
I still found it fun...――

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"I can't just accept it like you do...!
Not the race... and not myself...!!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Shion-sanâ

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "...I plan to run even better in the Tenno Sho (Spring) than I did today!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I will defeat Gold Ship-san there,
and you as well...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Well then—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: ...Unable to accept the race or herself, huh.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(Still, you see, Shion-san.
My hearing happens to be rather sharp――)

text_block_list.name: Shion Fan A
text_block_list.text: "That was a great race today too, Variation...! I'll be rooting for you at the Tenno Sho (Spring) as well!!"

text_block_list.name: Shion Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Shion-chan was so cool...! 
I definitely have to go watch her next time too...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
(...We have to make this a wonderful session
so that voice rings out even louder
and reaches Shion-san.)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu—
Now I'm getting fired up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Sounds of Earth achieved a brilliant result
in the Nikkei Sho that would lead into the Tenno Sho (Spring)...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on the other hand—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Man, the Japanese contenders were so close...!
Peerless Shout fought hard for 3rd place!"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
“That was a nice fight!!
That smile of leaving it all on the track
was so incredibly cool!!”

text_block_list.name: Peerless Shout
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
I gave it everything I had...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though Peerless Shout fell short of victory
at the Dubai International GⅠ, she ran a strong race,
making Japan's presence known on the world stage.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It proved to be a tremendously encouraging race
for Sounds of Earth, with the fiercely contested
Tenno Sho (Spring) lying ahead—
